open_questions.q: On a terms version bump, must previously-accepted teachers re-accept before their next upload (block re-engages), or is it a non-blocking notification only?
open_questions.proposed_answer: Forced re-acceptance before next upload, to best serve the legal-compliance goal.

open_questions.q: Should the acceptance UX be an inline blocking modal at first upload, or a standalone terms page linked from the auth and upload flows?
open_questions.proposed_answer: Affirmative checkbox at point of first upload with the full terms viewable; modal-vs-page deferred to solution design.

open_questions.q: Does this ticket wait for auth (#2), DB (#3), and upload (#4), build against stubs, or deliver only the isolated acceptance-gate slice?
